title: The Relativity Annex

sources.where: Choudhuri Ch. 12 (tensors, Christoffel symbols 12.31, Riemann 12.37, Ricci 12.41, Einstein equation 12.47) and its Exercises 12.1-12.7, pp. 384-385
Choudhuri Ch. 13 (Schwarzschild 13.13, orbits 13.21-13.32, light 13.38, linear theory and gravitational waves 13.79-13.84) and its Exercises 13.1-13.7, pp. 416-417

intro: The general-relativity chapters of Choudhuri (12 and 13): tensors, curvature, the Schwarzschild solution and gravitational waves. Exam priority: low. Recent exams did not ask about them beyond the FRW/Friedmann and Schwarzschild basics, so do this room after the A-topics, or when the lecture slides show they are covered. Everything here is the book's end-of-chapter exercises, at the Book exercises console.
